items.name: Sertraline HCl
items.facts: Updated label for Sertraline HCl (Biocon Pharma Inc.). Boxed warning: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies. Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening, and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] . WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS AND BEHAVIORS See full prescribing information for complete boxed warning. Increased risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in pedia
items.summary: Biocon Pharma Inc. has updated the boxed warning on Sertraline HCl regarding increased risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients.

items.name: Carbamazepine
items.facts: Updated label for Carbamazepine (Jubilant Cadista Pharmaceuticals Inc.). Boxed warning: WARNINGS SERIOUS DERMATOLOGIC REACTIONS AND HLA-B * 1502 ALLELE SERIOUS AND SOMETIMES FATAL DERMATOLOGIC REACTIONS, INCLUDING TOXIC EPIDERMAL NECROLYSIS (TEN) AND STEVENS-JOHNSON SYNDROME (SJS), HAVE BEEN REPORTED DURING TREATMENT WITH CARBAMAZEPINE. THESE REACTIONS ARE ESTIMATED TO OCCUR IN 1 TO 6 PER 10,000 NEW USERS IN COUNTRIES WITH MAINLY CAUCASIAN POPULATIONS, BUT THE RISK IN SOME ASIAN COUNTRIES IS ESTIMATED TO BE ABOUT 10 TIMES HIGHER. items.summary: Jubilant Cadista Pharmaceuticals Inc. updated the boxed warning for Carbamazepine regarding serious dermatologic reactions, including toxic epidermal necrolysis and Stevens-Johnson syndrome, associated with the HLA-B*1502 allele.

why_it_matters.text: These boxed warning label updates for Biocon Pharma Inc. and Jubilant Cadista Pharmaceuticals Inc. directly impact product labeling and patient safety compliance for sertraline and carbamazepine [623b9672-b41e-4ec9-b2cc-f5bb383c39ba@20261023, 7c1dd8ce-c490-40b4-b17a-da331df24cba@20261023].
